title: When the Salt Turns
author: Freya Ravensworth
blurb: Zephyrine Marchetti, an exiled storm-caller, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
